passages.text: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.
passages.sermon:
God existed before everything.
God began creation.
God created the heavens.
God created the earth.
passages.original: בְּרֵאשִׁ֖ית בָּרָ֣א אֱלֹהִ֑ים אֵ֥ת הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וְאֵ֥ת הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: Now the earth was formless and void, and darkness was over the surface of the deep. And the Spirit of God was hovering over the surface of the waters.
passages.sermon:
God created the heavens and the earth.
The earth had no shape.
The earth was empty.
Darkness covered the deep waters.
The Spirit of God moved above the waters.
passages.original: וְהָאָ֗רֶץ הָיְתָ֥ה תֹ֙הוּ֙ וָבֹ֔הוּ וְחֹ֖שֶׁךְ עַל־ פְּנֵ֣י תְה֑וֹם וְר֣וּחַ אֱלֹהִ֔ים מְרַחֶ֖פֶת עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י הַמָּֽיִם׃

passages.text: And God said, “Let there be light,” and there was light.
passages.sermon:
God created the heavens and the earth in the beginning.
God spoke.
God said, “Let there be light.”
Light appeared.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֖ים יְהִ֣י א֑וֹר וַֽיְהִי־ אֽוֹר׃

passages.text: And God saw that the light was good, and He separated the light from the darkness.
passages.sermon: God saw the light.\r\nGod saw that the light was good.\r\nGod separated the light from the darkness.
passages.original: וַיַּ֧רְא אֱלֹהִ֛ים אֶת־ הָא֖וֹר כִּי־ ט֑וֹב וַיַּבְדֵּ֣ל אֱלֹהִ֔ים בֵּ֥ין הָא֖וֹר וּבֵ֥ין הַחֹֽשֶׁךְ׃

passages.text: God called the light “day,” and the darkness He called “night.” And there was evening, and there was morning—the first day.
passages.sermon:
God created light.
God named the light “day.”
God created darkness.
God named the darkness “night.”
Evening came.
Morning came.
This was the first day.
passages.original: וַיִּקְרָ֨א אֱלֹהִ֤ים׀ לָאוֹר֙ י֔וֹם וְלַחֹ֖שֶׁךְ קָ֣רָא לָ֑יְלָה וַֽיְהִי־ עֶ֥רֶב וַֽיְהִי־ בֹ֖קֶר י֥וֹם אֶחָֽד׃פ

passages.text: And God said, “Let there be an expanse between the waters, to separate the waters from the waters.”
passages.sermon:
God is the Creator.
God spoke.
God said, “Let there be an expanse in the middle of the waters.”
God said, “Let the expanse separate the waters from the waters.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֔ים יְהִ֥י רָקִ֖יעַ בְּת֣וֹךְ הַמָּ֑יִם וִיהִ֣י מַבְדִּ֔יל בֵּ֥ין מַ֖יִם לָמָֽיִם׃

passages.text: So God made the expanse and separated the waters beneath it from the waters above. And it was so.
passages.sermon: God created the expanse.\r\nGod separated the waters under the expanse from the waters above the expanse.\r\nThis happened as God said.
passages.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ אֱלֹהִים֮ אֶת־ הָרָקִיעַ֒ וַיַּבְדֵּ֗ל בֵּ֤ין הַמַּ֙יִם֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ מִתַּ֣חַת לָרָקִ֔יעַ וּבֵ֣ין הַמַּ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֖ר מֵעַ֣ל לָרָקִ֑יעַ וַֽיְהִי־ כֵֽן׃

passages.text: God called the expanse “sky.” And there was evening, and there was morning—the second day.
passages.sermon:
God created the expanse.
God called the expanse "sky."
Evening came.
Morning came.
This was the second day.
passages.original: וַיִּקְרָ֧א אֱלֹהִ֛ים לָֽרָקִ֖יעַ שָׁמָ֑יִם וַֽיְהִי־ עֶ֥רֶב וַֽיְהִי־ בֹ֖קֶר י֥וֹם שֵׁנִֽי׃פ

passages.text: And God said, “Let the waters under the sky be gathered into one place, so that the dry land may appear.” And it was so.
passages.sermon:
God is the Creator.
God spoke.
God said, “Let the waters under the sky be gathered into one place.”
God wanted the dry land to appear.
The waters gathered together.
The dry land appeared.
It happened just as God said.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֗ים יִקָּו֨וּ הַמַּ֜יִם מִתַּ֤חַת הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ אֶל־ מָק֣וֹם אֶחָ֔ד וְתֵרָאֶ֖ה הַיַּבָּשָׁ֑ה וַֽיְהִי־ כֵֽן׃

passages.text: God called the dry land “earth,” and the gathering of waters He called “seas.” And God saw that it was good.
passages.sermon:
God acted as Creator.
God named the dry land “earth.”
God named the gathered waters “seas.”
God saw that the earth and the seas were good.
passages.original: וַיִּקְרָ֨א אֱלֹהִ֤ים׀ לַיַּבָּשָׁה֙ אֶ֔רֶץ וּלְמִקְוֵ֥ה הַמַּ֖יִם קָרָ֣א יַמִּ֑ים וַיַּ֥רְא אֱלֹהִ֖ים כִּי־ טֽוֹב׃

passages.text: Then God said, “Let the earth bring forth vegetation: seed-bearing plants and fruit trees, each bearing fruit with seed according to its kind.” And it was so.
passages.sermon:
God spoke.
God is the Creator.
God said, “Let the earth produce vegetation.”
God commanded the earth to grow green plants.
God commanded the earth to grow plants that make seeds.
God commanded the earth to grow fruit trees.
Each fruit tree makes fruit with seeds inside it.
Each plant and tree produces according to its kind.
The earth obeyed God.
It happened as God said.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֗ים תַּֽדְשֵׁ֤א הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ דֶּ֔שֶׁא עֵ֚שֶׂב מַזְרִ֣יעַ זֶ֔רַע עֵ֣ץ פְּרִ֞י עֹ֤שֶׂה פְּרִי֙ לְמִינ֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר זַרְעוֹ־ ב֖וֹ עַל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וַֽיְהִי־ כֵֽן׃

passages.text: The earth produced vegetation: seed-bearing plants according to their kinds and trees bearing fruit with seed according to their kinds. And God saw that it was good.
passages.sermon:
God created the earth.
God caused the earth to produce vegetation.
The earth produced grass.
The earth produced plants that make seeds.
Each plant made seeds according to its kind.
The earth produced trees that make fruit.
Each tree made fruit with seeds according to its kind.
God saw what the earth produced.
God saw that it was good.
passages.original: וַתּוֹצֵ֨א הָאָ֜רֶץ דֶּ֠שֶׁא עֵ֣שֶׂב מַזְרִ֤יעַ זֶ֙רַע֙ לְמִינֵ֔הוּ וְעֵ֧ץ עֹֽשֶׂה־ פְּרִ֛י אֲשֶׁ֥ר זַרְעוֹ־ ב֖וֹ לְמִינֵ֑הוּ וַיַּ֥רְא אֱלֹהִ֖ים כִּי־ טֽוֹב׃

passages.text: And there was evening, and there was morning—the third day.
passages.sermon:
God created the world.
God divided time into days.
Evening came.
Morning came.
This was the third day.
passages.original: וַֽיְהִי־ עֶ֥רֶב וַֽיְהִי־ בֹ֖קֶר י֥וֹם שְׁלִישִֽׁי׃פ

passages.text: And God said, “Let there be lights in the expanse of the sky to distinguish between the day and the night, and let them be signs to mark the seasons and days and years.
passages.sermon:
God spoke.
God said, "Let there be lights in the sky."
These lights will separate day from night.
These lights will be signs.
These lights will mark seasons.
These lights will mark days.
These lights will mark years.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֗ים יְהִ֤י מְאֹרֹת֙ בִּרְקִ֣יעַ הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם לְהַבְדִּ֕יל בֵּ֥ין הַיּ֖וֹם וּבֵ֣ין הַלָּ֑יְלָה וְהָי֤וּ לְאֹתֹת֙ וּלְמ֣וֹעֲדִ֔ים וּלְיָמִ֖ים וְשָׁנִֽים׃

passages.text: And let them serve as lights in the expanse of the sky to shine upon the earth.” And it was so.
passages.sermon: God created lights in the sky.\r\nThese lights shine on the earth.\r\nGod made it happen just as He said.
passages.original: וְהָי֤וּ לִמְאוֹרֹת֙ בִּרְקִ֣יעַ הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם לְהָאִ֖יר עַל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וַֽיְהִי־ כֵֽן׃

passages.text: God made two great lights: the greater light to rule the day and the lesser light to rule the night. And He made the stars as well.
passages.sermon:
God created two great lights.
God made the greater light to rule the day.
God made the lesser light to rule the night.
God also made the stars.
passages.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ אֱלֹהִ֔ים אֶת־ שְׁנֵ֥י הַמְּאֹרֹ֖ת הַגְּדֹלִ֑ים אֶת־ הַמָּא֤וֹר הַגָּדֹל֙ לְמֶמְשֶׁ֣לֶת הַיּ֔וֹם וְאֶת־ הַמָּא֤וֹר הַקָּטֹן֙ לְמֶמְשֶׁ֣לֶת הַלַּ֔יְלָה וְאֵ֖ת הַכּוֹכָבִֽים׃

passages.text: God set these lights in the expanse of the sky to shine upon the earth, to preside over the day and the night, and to separate the light from the darkness. And God saw that it was good.
passages.sermon:
God set the lights in the sky.
He placed them in the expanse above the earth.
These lights shine on the earth.
They rule over the day and the night.
They separate light from darkness.
God saw that this was good.
passages.original: וַיִּתֵּ֥ן אֹתָ֛ם אֱלֹהִ֖ים בִּרְקִ֣יעַ הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם לְהָאִ֖יר עַל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃ וְלִמְשֹׁל֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם וּבַלַּ֔יְלָה וּֽלֲהַבְדִּ֔יל בֵּ֥ין הָא֖וֹר וּבֵ֣ין הַחֹ֑שֶׁךְ וַיַּ֥רְא אֱלֹהִ֖ים כִּי־ טֽוֹב׃

passages.text: And there was evening, and there was morning—the fourth day.
passages.sermon:
God created the world.
There was evening.
There was morning.
This was the fourth day.
passages.original: וַֽיְהִי־ עֶ֥רֶב וַֽיְהִי־ בֹ֖קֶר י֥וֹם רְבִיעִֽי׃פ

passages.text: And God said, “Let the waters teem with living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth in the open expanse of the sky.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke.
God gave a command.
God said, “Let the waters be filled with living creatures.”
God said, “Let birds fly above the earth.”
God said, “Let birds fly across the open sky.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֔ים יִשְׁרְצ֣וּ הַמַּ֔יִם שֶׁ֖רֶץ נֶ֣פֶשׁ חַיָּ֑ה וְעוֹף֙ יְעוֹפֵ֣ף עַל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ עַל־ פְּנֵ֖י רְקִ֥יעַ הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃

passages.text: So God created the great sea creatures and every living thing that moves, with which the waters teemed according to their kinds, and every bird of flight after its kind. And God saw that it was good.
passages.sermon:
God created the great sea creatures.
God created every living thing that moves in the waters.
Each living thing in the waters was made according to its kind.
God created every bird that flies.
Each bird was made according to its kind.
God saw what He had made.
God saw that it was good.
passages.original: וַיִּבְרָ֣א אֱלֹהִ֔ים אֶת־ הַתַּנִּינִ֖ם הַגְּדֹלִ֑ים וְאֵ֣ת כָּל־ נֶ֣פֶשׁ הַֽחַיָּ֣ה׀ הָֽרֹמֶ֡שֶׂת אֲשֶׁר֩ שָׁרְצ֨וּ הַמַּ֜יִם לְמִֽינֵהֶ֗ם וְאֵ֨ת כָּל־ ע֤וֹף כָּנָף֙ לְמִינֵ֔הוּ וַיַּ֥רְא אֱלֹהִ֖ים כִּי־ טֽוֹב׃

passages.text: Then God blessed them and said, “Be fruitful and multiply and fill the waters of the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth.”
passages.sermon:
God created living creatures in the waters and birds in the sky.
God blessed these creatures.
God spoke to them.
God said, “Be fruitful.”
God said, “Multiply.”
God said, “Fill the waters in the seas.”
God said, “Let the birds multiply on the earth.”
passages.original: וַיְבָ֧רֶךְ אֹתָ֛ם אֱלֹהִ֖ים לֵאמֹ֑ר פְּר֣וּ וּרְב֗וּ וּמִלְא֤וּ אֶת־ הַמַּ֙יִם֙ בַּיַּמִּ֔ים וְהָע֖וֹף יִ֥רֶב בָּאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: And there was evening, and there was morning—the fifth day.
passages.sermon:
God created the world in six days.
This sentence describes the fifth day.
Evening came.
Morning came.
This was the fifth day.
passages.original: וַֽיְהִי־ עֶ֥רֶב וַֽיְהִי־ בֹ֖קֶר י֥וֹם חֲמִישִֽׁי׃פ

passages.text: And God said, “Let the earth bring forth living creatures according to their kinds: livestock, land crawlers, and beasts of the earth according to their kinds.” And it was so.
passages.sermon:
God spoke.
God gave a command.
God said, “Let the earth produce living creatures.
Let each kind appear.
Let there be livestock.
Let there be animals that crawl on the ground.
Let there be wild beasts of the earth.
Let each kind appear according to its own type.”
The earth produced these living creatures.
Everything happened as God commanded.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֗ים תּוֹצֵ֨א הָאָ֜רֶץ נֶ֤פֶשׁ חַיָּה֙ לְמִינָ֔הּ בְּהֵמָ֥ה וָרֶ֛מֶשׂ וְחַֽיְתוֹ־ אֶ֖רֶץ לְמִינָ֑הּ וַֽיְהִי־ כֵֽן׃

passages.text: God made the beasts of the earth according to their kinds, the livestock according to their kinds, and everything that crawls upon the earth according to its kind. And God saw that it was good.
passages.sermon:
God made the animals that live on the earth.
God made each kind of animal.
God made the livestock.
God made each kind of livestock.
God made everything that crawls on the ground.
God made each kind of crawling creature.
God saw what He had made.
God saw that it was good.
passages.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ אֱלֹהִים֩ אֶת־ חַיַּ֨ת הָאָ֜רֶץ לְמִינָ֗הּ וְאֶת־ הַבְּהֵמָה֙ לְמִינָ֔הּ וְאֵ֛ת כָּל־ רֶ֥מֶשׂ הָֽאֲדָמָ֖ה לְמִינֵ֑הוּ וַיַּ֥רְא אֱלֹהִ֖ים כִּי־ טֽוֹב׃

passages.text: Then God said, “Let Us make man in Our image, after Our likeness, to rule over the fish of the sea and the birds of the air, over the livestock, and over all the earth itself and every creature that crawls upon it.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke.
God said, "Let Us make man."
God said, "Let Us make man in Our image."
God said, "Let Us make man after Our likeness."
God said, "Let man rule over the fish of the sea."
God said, "Let man rule over the birds of the air."
God said, "Let man rule over the livestock."
God said, "Let man rule over all the earth."
God said, "Let man rule over every creature that crawls on the earth."
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֔ים נַֽעֲשֶׂ֥ה אָדָ֛ם בְּצַלְמֵ֖נוּ כִּדְמוּתֵ֑נוּ וְיִרְדּוּ֩ בִדְגַ֨ת הַיָּ֜ם וּבְע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֗יִם וּבַבְּהֵמָה֙ וּבְכָל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ וּבְכָל־ הָרֶ֖מֶשׂ הָֽרֹמֵ֥שׂ עַל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: So God created man in His own image; in the image of God He created him; male and female He created them.
passages.sermon:
God created man.
God made man in His own image.
God created man in the image of God.
God created them male and female.
passages.original: וַיִּבְרָ֨א אֱלֹהִ֤ים׀ אֶת־ הָֽאָדָם֙ בְּצַלְמ֔וֹ בְּצֶ֥לֶם אֱלֹהִ֖ים בָּרָ֣א אֹת֑וֹ זָכָ֥ר וּנְקֵבָ֖ה בָּרָ֥א אֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: God blessed them and said to them, “Be fruitful and multiply, and fill the earth and subdue it; rule over the fish of the sea and the birds of the air and every creature that crawls upon the earth.”
passages.sermon:
God created the first humans.
God gave them a blessing.
God spoke to them.
God said, “Be fruitful.
Multiply.
Fill the earth.
Subdue the earth.
Rule over the fish in the sea.
Rule over the birds in the sky.
Rule over every living creature that moves on the earth.”
passages.original: וַיְבָ֣רֶךְ אֹתָם֮ אֱלֹהִים֒ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר לָהֶ֜ם אֱלֹהִ֗ים פְּר֥וּ וּרְב֛וּ וּמִלְא֥וּ אֶת־ הָאָ֖רֶץ וְכִבְשֻׁ֑הָ וּרְד֞וּ בִּדְגַ֤ת הַיָּם֙ וּבְע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וּבְכָל־ חַיָּ֖ה הָֽרֹמֶ֥שֶׂת עַל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: Then God said, “Behold, I have given you every seed-bearing plant on the face of all the earth, and every tree whose fruit contains seed. They will be yours for food.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the people He created.
God said, “Look, I have given you something.
I have given you every plant that makes seeds.
These plants grow everywhere on the earth.
I have also given you every tree that has fruit with seeds inside it.
You may eat these plants and fruits for your food.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֗ים הִנֵּה֩ נָתַ֨תִּי לָכֶ֜ם אֶת־ כָּל־ עֵ֣שֶׂב׀ זֹרֵ֣עַ זֶ֗רַע אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־ פְּנֵ֣י כָל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ הָעֵ֛ץ אֲשֶׁר־ בּ֥וֹ פְרִי־ עֵ֖ץ זֹרֵ֣עַ זָ֑רַע לָכֶ֥ם יִֽהְיֶ֖ה לְאָכְלָֽה׃

passages.text: And to every beast of the earth and every bird of the air and every creature that crawls upon the earth—everything that has the breath of life in it—I have given every green plant for food.” And it was so.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to all living animals on the earth.
God spoke to every bird in the sky.
God spoke to every creature that crawls on the earth.
Each of these creatures has the breath of life in it.
God gave every green plant to them for food.
This happened as God said.
passages.original: וּֽלְכָל־ חַיַּ֣ת הָ֠אָרֶץ וּלְכָל־ ע֨וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֜יִם וּלְכֹ֣ל׀ רוֹמֵ֣שׂ עַל־ הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ בּוֹ֙ נֶ֣פֶשׁ חַיָּ֔ה אֶת־ כָּל־ יֶ֥רֶק עֵ֖שֶׂב לְאָכְלָ֑ה וַֽיְהִי־ כֵֽן׃

passages.text: And God looked upon all that He had made, and indeed, it was very good. And there was evening, and there was morning—the sixth day.
passages.sermon:
God created everything in the world.
God looked at all that He had made.
God saw that everything was very good.
Evening came.
Morning came.
This was the sixth day.
passages.original: וַיַּ֤רְא אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה וְהִנֵּה־ ט֖וֹב מְאֹ֑ד וַֽיְהִי־ עֶ֥רֶב וַֽיְהִי־ בֹ֖קֶר י֥וֹם הַשִּׁשִּֽׁי׃פ
